sources.label: Northwharf Pantry volunteer note
sources.text:
Northwharf Pantry volunteer note, October 2026.

Northwharf Pantry served 120 neighbours in October and raised GBP 8,000 at the autumn supper. The supper was on 4 October 2026. The pantry is a community kitchen in Northwharf.
